source.title: Greatwolf Outcast's Chainweave — item-side Wowhead Looter disenchanting results
source.author: Wowhead Looter (cumulative player submissions)

notes: Original Wowhead item-side cumulative Looter table reports 23 gear disenchants; Vibrant Shard appears in 15 reported operations (site displays 65%). '1-2' is the table's positive-stack range, not an operation histogram. The other output 200113 belongs to the SAME cumulative gear cohort. Combined material hits exceed casts, so co-occurrence is possible and overall zero-output operations are unknown. Patch 10.2.0 is the item's addition patch, NOT proven measurement patch. PTR page host does not establish PTR-era outcomes. No profession skill, item bonus/difficulty at disenchant, completed-user-log provenance, timestamp, per-material total units or 0-N histogram. Historical crowd data, not a current Retail baseline.
